passages: # Pricing and rate limits Use our models with pay-as-you-go billing on Meta Model API and in [Muse Code](https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code), or in Muse Code with a monthly [subscription](https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/subscriptions). This page covers pay-as-you-go: Model API bills text models per token, image generation per image, Muse Voice Transcribe by the hour of audio processed, and Segment Anything Model (SAM) per image or video frame segmented, with no minimums or upfront commitment.

- **Cached input costs less**: When part of your prompt matches a [cached prefix](https://dev.meta.ai/docs/prompt-caching), you pay the cached-input rate for those tokens. Check `cached_tokens` in the response to see how many were served from cache. - **No long-context premium**: you pay the same rate whether your context window is mostly empty or almost full. - **Web search grounding**: **$2.50 per 1,000 search queries**, in addition to the request's token cost.
